ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.

2. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

3. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.

4. When practising Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.

5. When practising Conversational Skills: Interviews, which approach is best? (1 mark)

6. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.

7. When practising Intensive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Listening.

8. When practising Conversational Skills: Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills: Etiquette.

10. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

11. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Public Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Public Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public Speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanics of Writing: The Arabic Calligraphy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Functional Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Creative Writing: Poems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Vocabulary Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Sentences: Compound and Complex Sentences and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
